intro: Trinidad and Tobago is a parliamentary republic.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is head of state, elected by parliament; the prime minister leads the government. Kamla Persad-Bissessar returned as prime minister in 2025. Tobago has its own House of Assembly.

chapters.title: Tobago
text: The Tobago House of Assembly runs many local services.

keyTerms.meaning: A republic where parliament chooses the government.
